en: Black‑and‑white image of a large multi‑storey wooden hotel with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, standing beside a dirt road lined with trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the road. A long sign on the hotel façade reads in German, identifying it as a mountain hotel named "Berg hotel" in Oberbärenburg. Additional German signage is visible on boards near the road.
